claims.quote: We are an existing customer in field services. Our workflow stopped after a configuration change. Please get support involved before discussing expansion. This is a support incident.

raw_proposal.draft:
Hello [Customer Name],

Thank you for reaching out. We understand that your workflow has stopped after a configuration change, and we appreciate your prompt communication. Our support team is currently looking into this issue and will get back to you shortly.

Once the issue is resolved, we would be happy to discuss any potential expansion opportunities with you. Please let us know if there's anything else we can assist you with in the meantime.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Cedar Systems Support Team
[Your Contact Information]
